title: Australia grows, but investment remains cautious
evidence: Australia's economy grew 0.4% in the June quarter and 2.1% over the year, while private investment was flat.

title: NVIDIA's growth confirms infrastructure demand
evidence: NVIDIA reported quarterly revenue of $96.2 billion, up 106% year-on-year, with data-centre revenue of $89.0 billion.

title: Salesforce converts AI demand into recurring revenue
evidence: Salesforce reported Agentforce and Data 360 annual recurring revenue near $3.9 billion, up more than 210% year-on-year.

title: Australia Post exposes the cost of transition
evidence: Australia Post recorded a $107.6 million underlying loss despite 4.0% revenue growth; property sales produced its reported pre-tax profit.

title: AI adoption is changing work before jobs
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
evidence: Sixty-one percent of service firms used AI, but only 4% of service adopters reported layoffs; retraining remained the primary workforce response.

title: AI productivity is outrunning enterprise profit
evidence: Eighty percent report individual productivity gains from AI, while 37% report positive enterprise earnings impact and 6% qualify as high performers.

title: Logistics AI budgets are not reaching profit
evidence: Among 30 major logistics operators, 97% call AI strategic and 67% have dedicated budgets, but 13% report measurable financial impact.

title: AI labour pressure is reaching young workers first
evidence: Employment for 22–25-year-olds in AI-exposed roles is 19% below the level implied by less-exposed peers, mainly through reduced hiring.

title: Oil, yields and geopolitical risk hit markets together
evidence: Fresh US strikes on Iranian targets lifted oil prices and bond yields as major US share indexes closed lower.

title: Trade uncertainty is redirecting factory investment
evidence: New foreign investment in Mexico fell 13% in the first half as companies reconsidered factories and supply chains amid continuing trade-pact uncertainty.
